_: Infinite-zoom chains for the zoom account (studio/zoom_gen.py, studio/zoom_video.py). Each chain is listed from the widest view to the closest; the Kaggle kernel makes the closest picture first and paints each wider one around it (the previous picture shrunk to the middle half), so zooming in passes through every layer without a cut. Every view is straight down (top-down), so the layers line up.
style: photorealistic, straight top-down view, natural daylight, sharp focus, highly detailed, no text, no people's faces
negative: text, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, blurry, lowres, cartoon, illustration, painting, deformed, tilted horizon, perspective view, sky
